name: Blade Fatigue Life and Tower Deflection — Wind Load Coupling
description: Blade fatigue load cycles and tower deflection are both driven by wind turbulence, creating a positive correlation: high-turbulence events simultaneously reduce fatigue life and increase tower deflection.

elements.name: Blade Fatigue Life
elements.description: Fatigue life at blade root. Positively correlated with tower deflection through wind load.

uncertainty.source: IEC 61400-1 aeroelastic simulation: OpenFAST with Kaimal turbulence, 100 seeds

elements.name: Tower Maximum Deflection
elements.description: Max fore-aft tower top deflection. Positively correlated with blade fatigue.

uncertainty.source: FEM sensitivity analysis with soil-foundation parameter variation (IEC 61400-1 DLC 1.3)

elements.name: Minimum Design Fatigue Life
elements.description: IEC 61400-1: minimum fatigue life for 20-year design lifetime

elements.name: Maximum Tower Deflection
elements.description: Blade-tower clearance: deflection above 0.60 m risks collision
